name: Seui
source:
Volunteer club member; Albatross

Part of a club at the university that disposes of soiled things. She won't leave a speck of dust.

The gun-shaped thing in her hands is actually a wireless vacuum cleaner. I've heard that the club recruitment numbers soared after they started using those things.
